scope: Existing Phase 0a evidence only. No source sweep, no automatic case extraction, no ledger/expectation/gate changes, and no Q3 duplication.
user_decisions: Approved narrow closure triage: retain concrete counterexamples, documented regressions, distinct missing premises, necessary positive controls, and documented operational regressions.
Group repeated incidents and metadata/status/corrected-report records; defer only wording-only, policy-ambiguous, or hypothetical weakness unless needed to interpret an existing incident.
Parent reports Q3 approved through case 408; these rows await the imminent parent decision record and are intentionally not duplicated.
This report proposes dispositions only; parent retains adjudication and no corpus action follows automatically.

necessary_gaps.protects_against: Carrying x=0 derived only from source ideal (x) to ambient target ideal (0), where x=1 falsifies it.
necessary_gaps.corpus_insufficiency: GP-A13-ambient is positive only because the identity is already ambient; it has the opposite premise.
necessary_gaps.smallest_action: One REFUSE/ACCEPT pair: source (x), ambient (0), DERIVED x=0 with witness x=1 must refuse; retain GP-A13-ambient as the positive ambient identity control.

necessary_gaps.protects_against: Mutation or deletion of protected inputs, and release/package artifacts whose retained bytes do not match the bound digest.
necessary_gaps.corpus_insufficiency: GP-X44, GP-X71/72, and GP-X213/214 cover changed fixtures or stored bytes, not aliases, foreign temporary ownership, copy-time changes, or protected output names.
necessary_gaps.smallest_action: One bounded parameterized custody harness with separate alias, foreign-temp, copy-digest, bound-output, and reserved-name parameters; every parameter must leave the protected source unchanged and either refuse or retain a verified digest.

necessary_gaps.protects_against: A validated execution record changing meaning after validation through lossy decoding, mutable abort metadata, or CAS-program-body mutation.
necessary_gaps.corpus_insufficiency: GP-X213/214 bind stored output bytes and GP-X242/X249 reject construction-time shadowing; none preserve identity through these three post-validation transitions.
necessary_gaps.smallest_action: One bounded harness with three distinct controls, each preserving its own gate: raw-byte identity, immutable abort reason, and immutable/revalidated CAS body before execution.

disposition_groups.name: receipt_kind_reuse_with_specific_generic_transport_limit
disposition_groups.basis: Q1 maps known LOCALIZED_UNIT_IDEAL_CERT without a current verdict to GP-X65 (REFUSE) and with one to GP-X66 (positive). GP-C01 separately covers replay-backed conditional base extension. The only residual is specific: retained generic UNIT_IDEAL_CERT hook classification has no receipt and no findings; generic transport classification and localized native handling are not identical. This is not a reason to recreate the known-kind/no-receipt control.

disposition_groups.name: documented_interface_and_operational_contract_incidents
disposition_groups.basis: Recorded behaviors violate an implemented or advertised operational boundary: raw TypeError instead of GraphError; exported/runtime schema disagreement; unexpected CAS reported healthy; JSON arrays terminate MCP/hook handling; a committed declaration followed by a rendering error has ambiguous retry state; distinct handoff contexts render identically; advertised floor is ignored; unknown FAILED defaults CLOSED; native-load refusal leaves no report; and changed decoder explanations are suppressed as unchanged. These remain incidents even though none asserts a mathematical false-held verdict.

disposition_groups.name: documented_custody_identity_and_lexical_incidents
disposition_groups.basis: Recorded behaviors break an operational identity contract: migration validates a generated replacement header rather than its old-epoch source header; checkout/pinned LF normalization differs; direct overlay accepts old ledger against changed packet content; duplicate open items inflate a receipt count; three stable-ID/fingerprint validators accept a terminal newline; run_cas records caller generators rather than parsed output; and the semantic fingerprint omits generators used in the declared model. The generator-fingerprint omission remains conservatively open as a documented binding boundary, because the batch supplies no changed-generator persistence contrast.

disposition_groups.name: wording_only_nonincident
disposition_groups.basis: The typed R success explanation says generic base change although the actual gate is ORDERED reach. R/C verdict behavior is already covered by A10-R/C; the batch records no contradictory result or missing operational state.

limits: A proposed nonincident/reuse group is not a closure decision.
KNOWN_DIFFERENCE and DIAGNOSTIC_OBSERVED records remain evidence but do not become executable refusal coverage.
Grouped operational incidents are not treated as equivalent: their per-ID recorded contract failures are retained in operational_reassessment.
The generic UNIT_IDEAL_CERT residual is a transport-classification question, not a missing known-kind/no-receipt case.

operational_reassessment.rule: A recorded failure of an implemented/advertised operational boundary remains an incident. Lack of a mathematical authority verdict is not a deferral reason. A conservative open item retains the incident while withholding a precise control where the existing evidence lacks the necessary contrast.
